commonObserver.scope: Supported identified semantic target and unique real native Switch leaf are traced separately. Buttons unchanged. Generic mechanism evidence does not establish any product pass/failure by itself.

ios.scope: Real package-importing SwiftUI app, current iOS simulator, XCUI runtime accessibility/real taps/native parent drags, same-process receipts. No generic SwiftUI UIFont/style-tree or expanded UIKit padding extraction.

ratings.rationale: The actual native tree and original images retain the full supplied service, location and old appointment day/time with correct title/current label for this mode. IDs are assessed separately under R13.
Actual native labels and original scroll images preserve caller group/row order, times, full details, availability and fee/reason metadata. No supplied row content is omitted.

Exactly the effective eligible row is selected in native state and visible radio/outline treatment at the required checkpoints; nil input has no automatic selection. The free preselected slot stays selected despite unrelated feeAccepted=true.

Real native row taps emit the one requested selection event; reactivation of the selected row emits none. The actual unavailable native Button descendant is disabled and its attempted row tap emits none. Compound wrapper enabled state is not confused with actual nested Button enabled state.

Actual native summary/guidance and original images show the required current selected day/time/fee, nil-selection helper, fee-awaiting guidance, accepted-fee reassurance and free-selection replacement as applicable to this case.

Actual conditional consent and native Switch value follow the controlled selection/Boolean. Supported native Switch-leaf activation emits one fee_accepted:true, caller echo changes value0→1, and later free selection hides consent. In the free/nil cases, no consent control is rendered, including free selection with feeAccepted=true.

Native primary enabled state matches the valid-selection/fee gate and real enabled activation emits the exact slot-specific confirm. Disabled activation emits none. For non-choosing cases the initial callback receipt is empty, establishing no unsolicited render-time action.

Supported same-process caller echoes immediately update selected traits, consent value/visibility, summary/guidance and confirmation gate. In non-choosing cases actual render/native content ignores stale chooser input and uses the authoritative mode. Unexecuted external update branches are not claimed.

sourceChecks.rationale: Public Codable models, lowercase raw enums, associated actions and explicit public initializer/View API match. Source remains iOS14/macOS11-compatible with existing dependencies. Actual test-build log records TEST BUILD SUCCEEDED; supplied legacy-target typecheck logs contain no diagnostics. No legacy-OS runtime claim is made.
Effective selection derives from current input; controlled Binding reads current model and emits actions. No competing @State selection/consent or mutation of caller data.
Native Button/Toggle, coherent labels/selected traits/IDs and target minimum-frame declarations are present. Runtime native exposure/activation is assessed separately, not inferred from declarations.
ScaledMetric-based fonts and vertically expanding, horizontally wrapping Text; no line limits, ellipsis, shrink-to-fit or fixed text heights.
Intrinsic non-lazy VStack; no nested vertical ScrollView, fixed panel height or bounded lazy viewport.
Declarative light/dark palette and semantic leading/trailing alignment are provided. Literal palette declarations do not override the actual native disabled-style fade observed at runtime.

clusters.description: Native disabled PlainButtonStyle compounds explicit colors with a faded appearance; rendered solid pixels support approximately50% foreground/background blending. The causal mechanism is a supported source/render inference, not internal framework instrumentation.

missingEvidence.scope: Not exposed by generic SwiftUI AX. Source layout/font declarations, actual native actions and original screenshots are used only for the narrow assertions they establish.
Compatibility is source/build-reviewed. Native runtime evidence is current iOS only.
